Job Title - Experimental Machinist 3

Number of Positions - 1

Job Location - 1700 N. Research Park Way, Logan, Utah, United States of America, 84341-1941

Job Description -

NOTE: I am looking for a level 4 (Senior, most experienced) machinist, I am also open to a part-time worker if the candidate has the appropriate experience.
 

In need of an Experimental Machinist to work at its Logan, UT facility.  This position will be hired to level 4 (Senior).

 Our Logan, UT team researches, designs, develops, produces, and tests a variety of mechanical, electrical/electronic, and electro-optical equipment and systems including low background infrared scene/source generators, optical collimators and scan mirror systems, cryogenic positioning hardware, infrared imaging, and instrumentation of vacuum/space/environment chambers. We support multiple prime contractors in the development and production of both test systems and flight hardware for a multitude of applications including tactical missiles, launch detection, and missile defense systems. Our work protects our country from enemy threats.

 Job Description:

  • Plans the layout, fabrication, and testing of mechanical devices; sets up and operates any type of precision machine tool to make original parts, tools, mechanisms, and devices for experimental purposes.
  • Identifies raw material requirements for parts to be machined.
  • Solves problems relative to work-holding arrangement, unusual materials, machine settings, tools, product specifications, and fabrication methods for production process.
  • Normally performs precision work to exacting tolerances and dimensions for research engineers in a developmental laboratory condition.
  • May monitor and verify quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedures.
  • Typically requires completion of a formal apprenticeship and many years of precision all-around machining experience on unusual, original, and intricate layout, machining, and assembly tasks.

  Basic Qualifications – Machinist level 4

  • High school diploma or equivalent education
  • Minimum 6 years of experience working in a machine shop
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, sketches, GD&T, and other engineering specifications
  • Working knowledge of shop floor mathematics and measuring tools/equipment
  • Ability to use basic hand tools and precision measuring instruments
  • Ability to set up and operate a variety of manual machine tools including lathes, milling machines, and grinders
  • Ability to set up, program, and operate CNC machines including the use of Mastercam software
  • Ability to lift up to 50lbs
  • Ability to work safely and with concern for the safety of others

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates Degree
  • 6+ years of CNC 3-5-axis machining experience
  • Experience with and fundamental understanding of G-Code
  • CNC Machinist Certification from an accredited Trade School  
  • Ability to understand and work with knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles and disciplines. 
  • Experience in following written set-up instructions and/or performing unique setups
  • Demonstrated ability to solve unique machining challenges including reworking parts
  • Experience with Haas VMCs and/or EZ-Trak mills (Milltronics controls)
  • Experience with CNC lathes
  • Experience with EDM equipment
  • Experience TIG/GTAW welding aluminum and stainless steel
  • Excellent communication, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Willingness to learn and possess a positive team working attitude

Job Title: Kafka Administrator (Kafka Admin)
Location: Jersey City, NJ / Dallas, TX (Onsite)
Duration: 6 Months Contract
Client: TCS / End Client TBD
Interview: In-Person (Mandatory)
Experience: 10+ Years
Local Candidates: Jersey City, NJ or Dallas, TX Only

Job Summary

Seeking an experienced Kafka Administrator responsible for installing, configuring, maintaining, and monitoring Apache Kafka clusters. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, security, scalability, and performance of Kafka environments while supporting enterprise-level data streaming platforms.

Required Skills

  • Apache Kafka Administration
  • Confluent Kafka
  • Kafka Brokers, Topics, Partitions & Replication
  • Zookeeper / KRaft
  • Kafka Connect
  • Schema Registry
  • Linux Administration
  • Prometheus & Grafana Monitoring
  • JMX Monitoring
  • SSL/TLS, SASL, Kerberos Authentication
  • ACL (Access Control Lists)
  • Python / Bash / Java Scripting
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • Ansible / Terraform / Puppet
  • Disaster Recovery & High Availability
  • Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Kafka clusters.
  • Manage Kafka brokers, topics, partitions, replication, and retention policies.
  • Monitor cluster health, consumer lag, producer latency, and broker performance.
  • Implement security controls including SSL/TLS, SASL, Kerberos, and ACLs.
  • Troubleshoot Kafka infrastructure and perform root cause analysis.
  • Design and manage disaster recovery and high-availability solutions.
  • Automate provisioning, deployment, and monitoring activities.
  • Collaborate with application teams for Kafka onboarding and data pipeline optimization.

Job Title - Engineer Software 3

Number of Positions - 1

Job Location - 600 Hicks Road, Building 600 H Main, Rolling Meadows, Illinois, United States of America, 60008-1015

 

Job Description -

Our engineers are self-starters who are part of a team of software professionals developing world-class software to meet our customer’s high expectations. The Software Engineer designs, develops, operates, and maintains software components and computing systems software to be applied to and integrated with engineering, scientific and manufacturing requirements. The individual shall apply the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the system development life cycle to support the generation of engineering applications and products within the RF Business Unit. This includes interfacing with customers, application users and other technical and support personnel. The ideal individual will have experience including the full software development life cycle, which includes requirements, design, coding, testing, and integration.

Basic Qualifications for Engineer Software 3

·       Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar engineering discipline with a minimum of 5+ years of engineering experience, or 3+ years with a Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or similar engineering discipline or in lieu of degree, an additional 4 years of experience is required.

·       Object Oriented Programming in C++

·       Experience creating Graphical User Interfaces

·       Familiarity with Software architecture (design patterns, objected oriented design)

·       Familiarity with relational database management systems using SQL

·       Experience Developing Software running Windows Operating Systems

·       Experience with Software development methodologies and frameworks such as Waterfall Methodology and/or Agile.

·       Familiarity with various version control systems (Git, Gitlabs, Github, Bitbucket, ClearCase. etc) and Agile software planning tools (Rally, Jira, etc)

·       US Citizenship

·       Must be able to obtain an active Secret or Top-Secret Security Clearance and meet Enhanced Security Review criteria prior to start which may vary by program(s).

Preferred Qualifications for Engineer Software 3

·       Experience with Object Oriented Programming in C++ 11

·       Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Bash, Batch, etc)

·       Experience testing, debugging, and integrating Software on target hardware platforms

·       Experience with the Qt framework

·       Experience with DOORs requirements management

·       Active Secret Clearance

·       Differentiating characteristics include demonstrated leadership and teamwork capability, interpersonal communication skills and activities.

Job Title: .NET / Power BI Developer

Client: State of Mississippi (MDWFP)

Location: Jackson, MS (Onsite)

Job Type: Contract

Experience: 8-10+ Years

Visa: H1B, H4EAD, GC, USC (No Fake Profiles)

Rate: Open

Must Have Skills

  • Power BI (Mandatory)
  • C#
  • .NET / ASP.NET / .NET Core
  • SQL Server
  • DAX
  • Power Query
  • APIs
  • ETL / Data Transformation
  • Web Application Development

Job Description

The Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks (MDWFP) is seeking an experienced .NET / Power BI Developer to support application development, business intelligence, reporting, and modernization initiatives. The consultant will work closely with leadership, MIS teams, and business stakeholders to enhance applications, improve reporting capabilities, and deliver data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and .NET Core.
  • Develop Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets, semantic models, and visualizations.
  • Create data models, measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query.
  • Develop and support APIs, integrations, and internal business applications.
  • Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and database objects.
  • Support ETL processes, data transformation, reporting automation, and data quality improvements.
  • Troubleshoot application, reporting, and database-related issues.
  • Gather business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
  • Document system changes, report logic, and technical processes.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET, or .NET Core.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI development, dashboards, and reporting.
  • Experience with SQL Server, database development, and performance tuning.
  • Experience building APIs, Web Forms, and business applications.
  • Experience supporting web applications and web server environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • JavaScript
  • AngularJS
  • React JS
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • Bootstrap
  • Visual Basic
  • SQL Server
  • Azure
  • SharePoint
  • Microsoft 365
  • Entra ID

Preferred Experience

  • Government/Public Sector environment.
  • Executive dashboards and BI reporting solutions.
  • Data Governance and Security.
  • Application Modernization initiatives.
  • Process Improvement and Data Analytics projects.

Role: Sr. Product Design Engineer (SolidWorks)

Location: Carson, CA

Duration: Longterm

Pay Rate: DOE/ Flexible

Visa: USC 

 

Job Description:

 

We are currently seeking a Sr. Product Design Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will design consumer products with a specific focus on plastics that meet functional, aesthetic, safety and cost requirements while supporting cross-functional engineering and manufacturing needs. You will contribute technical expertise throughout the product development cycle, including concept creation, prototyping and durability evaluation. You will also collaborate across teams, clearly communicate design intent and work with a range of materials to deliver reliable, high-quality product solutions. Applicants should have a strong understanding of product design principles, including functionality, durability, safety and cost considerations. The ideal candidate also possesses EIT and/or PE certification. 

A day on the job looks like this: 

  • Designing consumer products in SolidWorks, ensuring functionality, durability, safety and alignment with cost targets 

  • Partnering with Quality to evaluate testing results, address design risks and ensure solutions meet performance requirements 

  • Representing the engineering perspective in product development discussions, applying technical judgment to align designs with project goals 

  • Providing detailed responses to engineering and technical requests from cross-functional partners 

  • Building proof-of-concept models and prototypes using in-house 3-D printers and related tools 

  • Sharing design concepts and recommendations during product reviews and team discussions 

  • Collaborating across departments including international cross-functional partners to clearly translate technical concepts and support effective teamwork 

  • Performing stress analyses to support durability and performance assessment 

Qualifications

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required: 

  • 6+ years of experience in design engineering 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering 

  • Experience in:  

    • Principles of plastic part design, complex part assembly, GD&T, material selection   

    • Plastic part manufacturing (injection and blow molding), decoration and secondary operations (sonic welding, assembly, etc) 

    • Engineering and development of toys (or children’s products) and educational materials

    • Prototyping tools 

  • Proficiency in 3-D CAD design (SolidWorks), including assemblies and detailed drawings 

  • Strong understanding of product design principles, including functionality, durability, safety and cost considerations 

  • Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes and production methods 

  • Advanced knowledge of 3D modeling techniques for aesthetic and functional parts (Moldflow/FEA) 

  • Hands-on experience supporting manufacturing activities (e.g., vendor validation, inspections, assembly support, troubleshooting production issues)

Role: Senior Test Engineer

Location: Dallas; TX.

Duration: 24 months +

Visa: Open/ Any, however Min. 7 + Yrs of Exp. Mandatory.

Exp. Level: 9+ Yrs, Min 7+ Yrs for Strong candidates.

 

 

Job Summary:

 

As a member of the system test team, the Senior test engineer will actively participate in all phases of the software development life cycle. The Test engineer will gather requirements, conduct analysis, create application test plans and test cases based on business requirements and design, work with development team or clients to troubleshoot, resolve, document problems, perform various types of testing (compliance, integration, regression and acceptance), execute test cases/scripts (manual and automated), validate and present output results, test bug fixes, enter and track defects and create test processes and procedures as needed

 

Duties & Responsibilities:

 

            You will work with multiple cross functional engineering teams (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Software and Simulation etc.) to develop test strategies to ensure a high-quality system that addresses all customer requirements in a timely manner and within the allocated budget.

•           You will also interface and work directly with customers on requirements and project managers to coordinate project test activities.  You will design and develop customized testing procedures and oversee projects from initial testing through local or nationwide deployment.

•           You will review customer documentation to identify  and analyze all requirements

•           You will design test plans, test data test environment, scenarios, procedures and scripts to accurately assess that the developed system addresses all customer requirements.

•           You will create detailed, step-by-step documentation of test procedures to ensure repeatability, coverage of customer requirements and compliance with standards.

•           You will communicate clearly and effectively with project teams , project management and customers to facilitate quick resolution of problems and document resolution agreements.

•           You will identify, analyze and create detailed records of problems that appear during testing and work directly with developers to find solutions and develop retesting procedures.

•           You will track internal or customer reported problems, resolutions and bug fixes throughout testing procedure with standardized tool such as JIRA.

•           You will design and implement applicable automated testing tools and upgrade them as needed to ensure currency and accuracy.

•           You will provide frequent feedback to developers, including recommendations for improvements, evaluation of problems, potential solutions and discussion of further test requirements.

•           You will represent the company in customer-facing technical meetings supporting the project management, development and execution through various customer test phases.

•           You will ensure discipline related technical processes, procedures and best practices are followed in test engineering activities.

•           You will be willing to travel to the customer site to support software installation, system testing and troubleshooting.    

 

Required Skills & Abilities:

 

1.          Technical Proficiency:

•                     Programming Languages: Knowledge of languages such as VB, C, C++. etc.

•                     Manual Testing: Strong skills in manual testing techniques and methodologies.

2.         Testing Frameworks:

•                     Familiarity with various testing frameworks and their implementation.

3.         Quality Assurance:

•                     Understanding of QA processes, standards and best practices.

•                     Ability to design and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases.

4.         Problem-Solving:

•                     Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve defects.

5.         Communication:

•                     Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with development teams and stakeholders.

•                     Ability to document test results and create detailed reports.

6.         Leadership and Mentoring:

•                     Experience in leading and mentoring junior testers.

•                     Ability to manage and coordinate testing activities within a team.

7.         Project Management:

•                     Skills in managing testing projects, including planning, scheduling and tracking progress.

8.         Attention to Detail:

•                     A keen eye for detail to ensure thorough testing and high-quality software.

9.         Continuous Learning:

•                     Commitment to staying updated with the latest testing tools, technologies and industry trends.

 

Education:

College Degree

Client - LPL

Site Reliability Engineer

 

We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with a strong application engineering background to improve application reliability, observability, and incident resolution across a complex enterprise landscape.

This role will focus on understanding application behavior, diagnosing performance issues, and reducing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), rather than solely managing infrastructure or CI/CD pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

Application Reliability & Issue Resolution

  • Analyze and troubleshoot application failures, latency issues, and degraded performance across distributed systems
  • Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) to identify underlying application-level issues
  • Work with engineering teams to quickly isolate failing components and dependencies
  • Reduce MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) through improved diagnostics and runbooks

Application Observability & Diagnostics

  • Assess current application landscape and identify gaps in logging, tracing, and monitoring
  • Implement and enhance application-level observability (logs, metrics, traces)
  • Enable faster issue identification by improving service visibility and dependency mapping
  • Define and standardize health checks and alerting strategies for applications

System Understanding & Mapping

  • Develop a clear understanding of application architecture, data flows, and service dependencies
  • Build and maintain application topology and dependency maps
  • Identify single points of failure and performance bottlenecks

Performance Engineering

  • Analyze application performance and recommend improvements for scalability and responsiveness
  • Identify issues related to threading, memory, database interactions, and API latency
  • Work with developers to optimize code paths, queries, and service interactions

Incident Management & Process Improvement

  • Lead or support incident triage and war-room calls
  • Improve incident response processes and escalation paths
  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and troubleshooting guides
  • Identify recurring issues and drive permanent fixes vs temporary patches

Collaboration & Engineering Enablement

  • Partner with application development teams to embed reliability best practices
  • Provide guidance on error handling, resiliency patterns, and fault tolerance
  • Enable teams with tools and practices for self-service diagnostics

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in application engineering, production support, or SRE roles
  • Strong experience in application troubleshooting and debugging (Java/.NET/Node.js preferred)
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and microservices architectures
  • Experience with application logs, debugging tools, and performance profiling
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of API behavior, database interactions, and system integrations
  • Experience working in production support / incident management environments

Preferred Skills

  • Experience implementing distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin)
  • Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Exposure to resiliency patterns (circuit breakers, retries, fallbacks)
  • Experience with performance tuning and load analysis

Job Title : Product Manager III – Restaurants

Location: Irving, TX - 5 days onsite

Client : 7-Eleven

Work Location: Irving, TX or Remote

 

Product Manager III – Restaurants

Who We Are

With more than 13,000 stores in the U.S. and 84,500 stores globally, it is no wonder 7-Eleven, Inc. has been named an iconic brand. In addition to 7-Eleven stores, 7-Eleven, Inc. also operates and franchises Restaurants; Laredo Taco Company, Raise the Roost, TDs deli, Parlor Pizza and more.

Since inventing the convenience industry in 1927, 7-Eleven has built a rich 96-year history filled with beloved products like Slurpee, Big Gulp and Big Bite, and fan-favorite holidays like Slurpee Day and Bring Your Own Cup Day. Now, 7-Eleven is on a mission to contemporize the brand and redefine convenience – and we need your help.

About This Opportunity

Overview:

The Product Manager III is responsible for elevating and modernizing the 7-Eleven Restaurant Technology products for our team members.  As a Product Manager, you'll develop new experiences that will not only transform the business but will shape our digital future. You will define product strategy, develop, launch, and enhance products and services that drive our business forward. You’ll work closely with stakeholders, UX and software development teams to define product requirements and coordinate resources from key stakeholders. You'll also be responsible for identifying and tracking KPIs as you build these amazing experiences. The ideal candidate is a highly organized individual with a passion for user experience and professional experience building impactful and meaningful customer experiences.

Responsibilities:

50% Strategy & Planning:

  • Seeks to empathize with and understand the end user deeply and use that knowledge to determine the fastest path to deliver value
  • Translates business goals and end user needs into product strategy; communicates direction and product priorities to the development team, other matrixed teams, and third-party partners
  • Identifies goals, metrics and analytics to determine product value; continually makes recommendations and refinements to the product backlog based on learnings
  • Manages and grooms the product backlog; makes future decisions based on the value that will be delivered
  • Monitors research as well as the competitive landscape to recommend the best solutions and ensure that products remain or become best in class
  • Ensures that product directions balance both the user needs and business goals of driving sales, improving efficiency and enhancing customer satisfaction

25% Delivery & Execution:

  • Works with user research and testing team to formulate, test and refine assumptions and hypotheses through user research and testing
  • Creates, prioritizes and accepts user stories; incorporates them into release planning
  • Makes product decisions that drive value on a daily basis
  • Identifies and considers pros, cons, issues, obstacles, dependencies and value associated with features and enhancements
  • Leads and mentors the team in standups, iteration planning sessions, product demos, and retrospectives.
  • Condenses complex technical concepts into non-technical language for stakeholders

25% Team & Stakeholder:

  • Set clear goals and expectations for the team aligned with business objectives
  • Act as a bridge between product teams and other departments (engineering, UX, marketing, etc.)
  • Ensure the team communicates effectively and delivers on commitments
  • Acts as a proponent of modern agile development practices
  • Advocates for the end user and stakeholder by becoming associated with the product, empathizing with and understanding user needs
  • Manages cross functional team and stakeholder expectations to execute on product strategy and provides education to requestors to determine prioritization based on tangible benefits and/or user experience

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree
  • 8+ years of experience in digital/agile product management
  • Proven experience in translating customer needs into product features and user interface design, with proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, wireframing and analytics software.
  • Strong Analytical skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or Masters degree
  • Experience in retail or e-commerce platforms
  • Position not eligible for sponsorship

  • Translates business goals and end user needs into product strategy; communicates direction and product priorities to the development team, other matrixed teams, and third-party partners
  • Identifies goals, metrics and analytics to determine product value; continually makes recommendations and refinements to the product backlog based on learnings
  • Manages and grooms the product backlog; makes future decisions based on the value that will be delivered
  • Monitors research as well as the competitive landscape to recommend the best solutions and ensure that products remain or become best in class
  • Ensures that product directions balance both the user needs and business goals of driving sales, improving efficiency and enhancing customer satisfaction

25% Delivery & Execution:

  • Works with user research and testing team to formulate, test and refine assumptions and hypotheses through user research and testing
  • Creates, prioritizes and accepts user stories; incorporates them into release planning
  • Makes product decisions that drive value on a daily basis
  • Identifies and considers pros, cons, issues, obstacles, dependencies and value associated with features and enhancements
  • Leads and mentors the team in standups, iteration planning sessions, product demos, and retrospectives.
  • Condenses complex technical concepts into non-technical language for stakeholders

25% Team & Stakeholder:

  • Set clear goals and expectations for the team aligned with business objectives
  • Act as a bridge between product teams and other departments (engineering, UX, marketing, etc.)
  • Ensure the team communicates effectively and delivers on commitments
  • Acts as a proponent of modern agile development practices
  • Advocates for the end user and stakeholder by becoming associated with the product, empathizing with and understanding user needs
  • Manages cross functional team and stakeholder expectations to execute on product strategy and provides education to requestors to determine prioritization based on tangible benefits and/or user experience

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree
  • 8+ years of experience in digital/agile product management
  • Proven experience in translating customer needs into product features and user interface design, with proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, wireframing and analytics software.
  • Strong Analytical skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or Masters degree
  • Experience in retail or e-commerce platforms
  • Position not eligible for sponsorship

"• Languages: Scala, Python (PySpark), SQL
• Big Data: Apache Spark (Core, SQL, Structured Streaming)
• Streaming: Kafka
• Ingestion / Orchestration: Apache NiFi
• Storage: Apache Ozone, Ceph, object storage concepts

"We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in Apache Spark, Scala, and PySpark to build and operate large scale batch and streaming data processing systems. The role has a strong emphasis on real time streaming architectures using Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming, alongside ingestion and orchestration with Apache NiFi and scalable storage using Apache Ozone and Ceph. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex performance, scalability, latency, and reliability challenges in production data platforms.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain large scale Spark applications using Scala and PySpark
• Build and operate streaming heavy data pipelines using Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming
• Implement stateful streaming patterns including windowing, watermarking, late data handling, and checkpointing
• Develop robust event replay and reprocessing workflows using Kafka offsets and partitions
• Build ingestion and routing flows using Apache NiFi, including Kafka based ingestion patterns
• Implement end to end ETL/ELT pipelines with strong emphasis on low latency, fault tolerance, and scalability
• Optimize Spark jobs through partitioning strategies, memory tuning, shuffle optimization, and efficient data formats
• Integrate Spark workloads with distributed object storage systems such as Apache Ozone and Ceph
• Ensure data quality, consistency, and auditability through validation, reconciliation, and metadata capture
• Collaborate with platform, infrastructure, and operations teams on production readiness and capacity planning
• Support production systems, including monitoring, incident analysis, and root cause resolution
• Contribute to reusable frameworks, coding standards, and engineering best practices
• Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical documentation
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
• Strong hands on experience with Apache Spark in production environments
• Advanced proficiency in Scala and PySpark
• Solid understanding of distributed systems and data processing at scale
• Strong experience with Kafka based streaming architectures
• Hands on experience with Spark Structured Streaming
• Experience building batch and real time pipelines
• Hands on experience with Apache NiFi for data ingestion and flow management
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured and semi structured data
• Experience working with object storage or distributed storage platforms
• Proficiency with Linux, shell scripting, and Git based version control
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Apache Ozone and/or Ceph as storage backends for analytics workloads
• Experience implementing exactly once / at least once streaming semantics
• Strong background in Spark performance tuning (CPU, memory, I/O, shuffle)
• Experience supporting mission critical production systems with strict SLAs
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for data applications
Experience designing observability for streaming systems (lag, throughput, backpressure)"

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain large scale Spark applications using Scala and PySpark

• Build ingestion and routing flows using Apache NiFi, including Kafka based ingestion patterns
• Implement end to end ETL/ELT pipelines with strong emphasis on low latency, fault tolerance, and scalability

• Integrate Spark workloads with distributed object storage systems such as Apache Ozone and Ceph

• Strong background in Spark performance tuning (CPU, memory, I/O, shuffle)
• Experience supporting mission critical production systems with strict SLAs
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for data applications
Experience designing observability for streaming systems (lag, throughput, backpressure)"

Role Name - IDMC Data Lineage Developer

ROLE_DESCRIPTION -

We are seeking an experienced Informatica IDMC Data Lineage Specialist to support our enterprise data governance and metadata management initiatives. This role will focus on implementing, managing, and optimizing data lineage capabilities using Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), Enterprise Data Catalog (EDC), and related tools to ensure data transparency, compliance, and trust across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Implement and configure Informatica IDMC data lineage capabilities, including metadata scanning, parsing, linking, and visualization.

Build and maintain end-to-end data lineage maps for critical data assets across multiple systems (e.g., databases, ETL, cloud, BI tools).

Collaborate with Data Governance, Data Engineering, and Business Teams to identify and onboard key metadata sources into Informatica IDMC.

Ensure data lineage accuracy and quality by validating lineage paths, resolving lineage gaps, and documenting transformation logic.

Automate metadata ingestion from source systems like Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica PowerCenter/IICS, Tableau, etc.

Develop custom metadata parsers and lineage connectors if needed, using APIs or Informatica-provided SDKs.

Support data governance, regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and impact analysis through accurate lineage mapping.

Participate in the design and maintenance of metadata management workflows, policies, and lineage standards.

Train and support users on how to access and interpret lineage through the Informatica Data Catalog UI.

MSP Owner: Felix Avalos
Location: Warsaw, IN (hybrid)
Duration: 6 months
GBaMS ReqID: 10775787

Sr. Principal Lead/Architect/Engineer Workload Automation (IBM Tivoli-TWS/IWS)
Role Overview
We are seeking a Lead Workload Automation Engineer / Architect to define and drive the enterprise architecture, strategy, and operational model for IBM Tivoli/IBM Workload Scheduler (TWS/IWS) across distributed environments (on-prem and cloud). This role sets platform standards and reference designs, leads modernization and major upgrades/migrations, governs reliability and security practices, and serves as the senior technical partner for application, databases, and infrastructure organizations to deliver resilient, scalable scheduling services for mission-critical workloads. In addition, assist and supervise two job scheduling teams.



Must Haves
1. Hands on to the end-to-end architecture for the TWS/IWS platform (components, topology, environments, integrations), including standards, patterns, integrations and APIs (REST/SOAP), event-based scheduling, and real-time/on-demand workload patterns.
2. Experience with Tivoli Dynamic Workload Console (TDWC/TDWB) and critical path monitoring and integrating file transfer solutions (e.g., SFTP/PGP/GPG, managed file transfer platforms) into batch workflows.
3. Experience with SAP and other enterprise application integrations via TWS extended agents.
4. Experience building dashboards/metrics and integrating with observability platforms (e.g., Grafana/Graphite).
5. Databases: DB2 (HADR), Oracle/Postgres (familiarity)
6. Experience defining platform standards, leading upgrades/migrations, and coordinating cross-team delivery (e.g., change windows, cutovers, rollback planning).
7. Artificial Intelligence – Navigating all the AI APP – know how to communicate with it and know when not to use it when it does not meet your or the companies’ expectations





Key Responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end architecture for the TWS/IWS platform (components, topology, environments, integrations), including standards, patterns, and reference implementations.
• Provide technical oversight for additional (3rd-party) job scheduling platforms where used; establish operating standards, integration patterns, and support processes to ensure consistent controls and reliability.
• Lead enterprise-scale installations, upgrades, and migrations; define cutover/rollback strategies, coordinate change windows, and ensure readiness across dependent teams.
• Lead assessments of legacy scheduler instances and batch frameworks to identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or migration; produce target-state recommendations, sequencing/roadmaps, and risk-based migration plans.
• Define reliability engineering practices for workload automation: availability targets, capacity planning, performance tuning, monitoring/alerting, and continuous improvement.
• Design and validate high-availability and disaster recovery solutions (including DB2 HADR where applicable); plan and execute regular DR tests and remediate gaps.
• Establish governance for workload onboarding and job design: scheduling standards, dependency modeling, naming conventions, calendars, critical path optimization, and SLA/SLO management.
• Architect and productionize automation for platform operations and self-service (e.g., provisioning, reporting, batch controls) using shell/Python/Perl and enterprise tooling.
• Own security and compliance posture: access model (LDAP/SSO), least-privilege controls, audit evidence, vulnerability remediation, and secure configuration baselines.
• Manage and develop two teams (e.g., platform engineering and operations): set priorities and operating rhythms, oversee delivery and support outcomes, coach/mentor team members, and drive performance management in partnership with leadership.
• Be available for major outages and critical events related to job scheduling, including QEND activities up to four (4) times per fiscal year, providing incident leadership, stakeholder communications, and post-incident follow-up.
• Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours/weekend support as needed to maintain scheduling availability and meet business SLAs.
• Support a global operating model by working flexibly across EMEA and US business hours to provide required coverage and stakeholder overlap.
• Serve as escalation point for complex incidents; lead root-cause analysis and drive problem management to prevent recurrence.
• Mentor and guide engineers; lead technical design reviews, documentation/runbook standards, and knowledge sharing across the organization.
• Deep dive into other job scheduling teams like Automate, AS400 and Robot and assist in supervising these teams in IT Operations.
Required Qualifications
• High School Diploma or equivalent
• 10+ years of experience in enterprise workload automation, including 7+ years of hands-on IBM TWS/IWS/IWA administration in distributed environments.
• Bachelor’s degree or 10+ years of equivalent IT industry service experience
• For senior/lead equivalent roles, 8+ years of relevant ITSM/major incident operations experience may be required.
• IT Technology Certification is a plus
• Proven experience in a lead/architect capacity: defining platform standards/reference designs, guiding cross-team implementations, and making architecture decisions for reliability, scalability, and security.
• Strong Linux/UNIX engineering and production troubleshooting experience, including performance and availability triage.
• Advanced automation/scripting skills (shell plus Python and/or Perl) with experience building supported, maintainable operational tooling.
• Demonstrated ability to lead complex incident response and root-cause analysis, and to drive preventative action through problem management.
• Strong change leadership in regulated production environments (planning, risk management, implementation, validation, rollback) aligned with ITIL processes.
• Excellent stakeholder communication and ability to influence across applications, database, infrastructure, and security teams.
Preferred Qualifications
• DB2 administration experience, including High Availability Disaster Recovery (HADR); familiarity with Oracle/Postgres and SQL.
• Experience with TWS/IWS integrations and APIs (REST/SOAP), event-based scheduling, and real-time/on-demand workload patterns.
• Experience with Tivoli Dynamic Workload Console (TDWC/TDWB) and critical path monitoring.
• Experience integrating file transfer solutions (e.g., SFTP/PGP/GPG, managed file transfer platforms) into batch workflows.
• Experience with SAP and other enterprise application integrations via TWS extended agents.
• Experience building dashboards/metrics and integrating with observability platforms (e.g., Grafana/Graphite).
• Experience defining platform standards, leading upgrades/migrations, and coordinating cross-team delivery (e.g., change windows, cutovers, rollback planning).
• Familiarity with cloud patterns and automation (e.g., infrastructure-as-code concepts, container/VM scheduling considerations) in support of workload modernization.
• Hands-on experience across ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge) in an enterprise environment.
• ServiceNow experience, including incident lifecycle management, documentation standards, and reporting.
• Working knowledge of ITIL concepts and IT service management best practices.
• Artificial Intelligence – Navigating all the AI APP – know how to communicate with it and know when not to use it when it does not meet your or the companies’ expectations
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate issues and drive resolution.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-volume, high-urgency operations environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confident facilitation on conference bridges.
• Able to write and review technical documentation and knowledge articles.

Skills & Tools
• Workload Automation: IBM TWS/IWS/IWA, TDWC/TDWB, dynamic scheduling, JSDL
• Operating Systems: Linux, UNIX (AIX/SunOS), Windows (agent support)
• Databases: DB2 (HADR), Oracle/Postgres (familiarity)
• Scripting: Shell, Python, Perl
• ITSM/Monitoring: ITIL processes; integrations with tools such as ServiceNow, AppDynamics, OBM, Grafana/Graphite
• Security: LDAP/SSO concepts, role-based access, audit/patch compliance, Project Code :

Role: Defects Triage Lead

Descriptions:

Key Responsibilities
Defect Triage & Management

Analyze defects across modules such as:
Loan origination workflows
Credit approvals
Document management
Integrations (e.g., credit bureaus, core banking systems)

Quality & Process Improvement
Establish and govern defect triage best practices specific to Salesforce/nCino
Identify recurring issues and drive root cause analysis (RCA)
Recommend improvements in:
Validation rules
Configurations
Data quality
Integration stability
Ensure adherence to release timelines and banking compliance standards

STRONG STERLING OMS PROFILES will be considered if Kibo skill is not available. Needs to be able to ramp-up on Kibo quickly.

Competencies: 10+ years experience required
Order and Service Management

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills - Overview
A Techno-Functional OMS Manager to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of AutoZone’s Order Management ecosystem.
The role will focus on enhancing and integrating Kibo OMS, Orderful, and Kibo Drop Ship capabilities, ensuring seamless end-to-end order orchestration and fulfillment processes across enterprise systems.

STRONG STERLING OMS PROFILES will be considered if Kibo skill is not available. Needs to be able to ramp-up on Kibo quickly.

Key Responsibilities:
Functional & System Ownership
• Own and manage AutoZone OMS landscape (Kibo, Orderful, Drop Ship modules)
• Document and enhance current OMS capabilities, workflows, and integrations
• Define and optimize end-to-end order lifecycle scenarios (order capture, routing, fulfillment, drop ship)
Integration & Solutioning
• Drive seamless integration between Orderful and Kibo OMS including Drop Ship
• Collaborate with engineering teams on API-led, event-driven integrations
• Ensure alignment with existing AZ enterprise systems and processes
Assessment & Gap Analysis
• Conduct current state assessments of OMS capabilities
• Perform technical and functional gap analysis
• Recommend solution approaches for Drop Ship enablement and OMS enhancements
Agile Delivery & Scrum Leadership
• Lead Scrum ceremonies, backlog grooming, and sprint execution
• Define and enforce Definition of Done and Definition of Ready
• Drive delivery within Agile / SAFe frameworks across cross-functional teams
Engineering & Delivery Execution
• Support engineering teams in standing up Kibo Drop Ship module
• Coordinate across development, QA, and integration teams
• Ensure delivery of scalable, high-quality OMS solutions
Stakeholder Collaboration
• Work with AutoZone business, IT, and external partners
• Facilitate alignment across teams for end-to-end solution delivery
• Ensure all stakeholders are aligned towards business outcomes and delivery milestones

Required Qualifications
• B Tech, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
• 10+ years of experience in Order Management Systems (OMS) preferably Kibo OMS / Retail Commerce platforms
• Strong techno-functional expertise in Kibo OMS, Orderful (or similar EDI/integration platforms), and Drop Ship processes
• Proven experience in system integration, API-based architectures, and enterprise application ecosystems
• Hands-on experience in Agile / Scrum
• Experience in functional design, system documentation, and process modeling
• Strong track record in gap analysis, solutioning, and end-to-end delivery execution

Roles & Responsibilities
• Own and manage end-to-end OMS ecosystem (Kibo, Orderful, Drop Ship)
• Enhance and document existing OMS capabilities, workflows, and integrations
• Drive integration between Orderful and Kibo OMS, including Drop Ship flows
• Perform functional and technical gap analysis and recommend improvements
• Lead Drop Ship module implementation and enablement
• Define and validate end-to-end order lifecycle scenarios (order to fulfillment)
• Lead Agile/Scrum delivery (ceremonies, backlog, sprint execution)
• Define and enforce Definition of Done and Ready
• Collaborate with business, IT, and external partners for solution alignment
• Ensure successful delivery of integration, engineering, and OMS enhancements

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Kibo Drop Ship module implementation
• Exposure to retail / omnichannel commerce ecosystems
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure / AWS) and integration tools
• Experience working with distributed global teams

Generic Managerial Skills, If any
Good organizational and problem-solving skills
Good team player who is self-motivated and well organized
Strong oral and written communication skills
Ability to work with remote teams
Ability to manage project scope, Project Code :

Role Name - Copilot Trainer

ROLE_DESCRIPTION -

Job Description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Trainer (AI Adoption & Enablement)
Role Title: Copilot Trainer – Microsoft 365 Copilot Enablement | Adoption & ROI Acceleration
Role Summary (What success looks like)
The Copilot Trainer is a functional Copilot expert and adoption practitioner responsible for driving awareness → capability → habit formation → measurable productivity outcomes for Microsoft 365 Copilot across targeted business personas. The trainer will present, demonstrate, and deliver webinars across the full M365 Copilot experience, teach prompting best practices, run persona discovery / day-in-the-life interviews, facilitate design thinking workshops, create lesson plans and hands on labs, run Change Corners, and execute targeted adoption campaigns to maximize usage, satisfaction, and ROI.
This role also requires a strong learning agility to stay current with Microsoft’s rapidly evolving Copilot feature set and incorporate new capabilities into training materials and delivery during the program.

Key Responsibilities
1) Copilot Enablement Delivery (Webinars, Demos, Hands on)
• Deliver high-impact live training (virtual / in-person) across Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences (e.g., Copilot in Teams, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and other supported M365 surfaces).
• Run role-based webinars, feature demonstrations, guided walkthroughs, and hands-on labs that map directly to real work tasks.
• Create and manage recorded training assets for asynchronous consumption (session recordings + quick reference guides).
• Facilitate office hours / clinics to reinforce learning, answer questions, and address user barriers (confidence, trust, relevance, and responsible use).
2) Prompt Writing & “Prompt Coaching” at Scale
• Train users on prompt fundamentals (context, goal, constraints, tone, structure, grounding, iteration).
• Build and maintain a persona-based prompt library and “best prompts” patterns aligned to common workflows.
• Provide “prompt coaching” during labs/clinics to improve quality of outcomes and reduce trial-and-error fatigue.
3) Persona Creation + Day-in-the-Life (DITL) Interviewing
• Lead persona discovery by interviewing business users and managers to understand:
o daily activities, information flows, documents, meetings, decision points, and pain areas
o where Copilot can reduce cycle time, improve quality, or automate drafting/summarization
• Conduct 10–15 structured interviews across roles (or as per program plan) and synthesize insights into role-based scenario maps.
• Translate insights into Top priority use cases and training tracks (focus on what drives real adoption, not generic feature training).
4) Design Thinking Workshops (Use-Case Identification & Workflow Mapping)
• Plan and facilitate design thinking sessions to capture:
o user journeys, workflow steps, “moments that matter,” friction points, and success criteria
• Convert workshop outcomes into:
o a prioritized use-case backlog
o role-based enablement journeys (basic → intermediate → advanced)
o practical labs that replicate daily work tasks
5) Learning Design: Lesson Plans + Persona-Based Paths
• Develop end-to-end lesson plans that include:
o objectives, prerequisite readiness, demo scripts, exercises, expected outcomes, and evaluation rubric
• Create persona-based learning paths for key functions such as:
o Finance, Legal/Compliance, Sales, HR, Operations, Executives (as applicable)
• Maintain reusable assets: slide decks, facilitator guides, learner workbooks, lab guides, Q&A sheets, and troubleshooting tips.
6) Change Corners / Change Kiosks / Community Building
• Run Change Corners (open houses) to enable two-way communication: what’s working, what’s blocked, what users need next.
• Support a champion / change agent network through train-the-trainer enablement, reinforcement content, and recognition mechanisms.
• Build community engagement via the adoption hub and internal channels (Teams/Viva Engage where used).
7) Adoption Campaigns + Communications (Awareness → Habit)
• Design and execute targeted campaigns:
o “Copilot Tips & Tricks” by persona
o “Use-case of the week”
o “Prompt of the week”
o success stories and leader messaging
• Partner with Communications/OCM leads to maintain cadence and reduce change fatigue.
8) Value Realization: ROI & Adoption Measurement Support
• Work with program leads to measure adoption and value:
o cohort ramp-up, attendance, engagement, satisfaction, scenario usage
o qualitative insights + “hours saved” narratives by persona
• Enable and interpret adoption dashboards and reinforce improvements based on trends.
• Drive outcomes aligned to the program’s adoption goals (e.g., scaling MAU, internal trainers certification, measurable ROI dashboards).
9) Train-the-Trainer (TTT) & Capability Transfer
• Lead and certify internal trainers (train-the-trainer model), enabling transition of ownership to client teams (e.g., 30+ certified internal trainers target).
• Provide trainer toolkits: facilitator scripts, demo environments, lab packs, scenario library, and FAQs.
10) Continuous Learning & Feature Velocity Readiness
• Maintain a structured mechanism to:
o track Microsoft Copilot feature updates
o update training materials and labs rapidly
o brief stakeholders on what’s new and how it impacts workflows
• Demonstrate sharp onboarding curve and adapt content during delivery without disrupting cadence.

Required Skills & Competencies
Core Copilot Expertise
• Strong hands-on experience delivering enablement for Microsoft 365 Copilot across major apps and key user scenarios.
• Ability to translate business tasks into Copilot workflows: summarization, drafting, re-writing, analysis, meeting intelligence, email triage, document understanding, and presentation creation.
Training & Facilitation
• Excellent presentation and storytelling ability; confident facilitating large webinars and interactive sessions.
• Adult learning design: lesson planning, learning paths, hands-on labs, assessments.
Discovery & Consulting Skills
• Interviewing and workshop facilitation (persona discovery, DITL, design thinking).
• Ability to synthesize insights into structured outputs: persona maps, scenario library, training backlog.
Change Management & Adoption
• Experience running adoption motions: champion networks, reinforcement loops, nudges, success stories, communication planning.
Data-driven Approach
• Comfort with adoption metrics, survey insights, and value narratives; ability to drive actions based on dashboards and feedback loops.
________________________________________
Qualifications / Experience
• 5+ years in training/facilitation, digital adoption, OCM, or productivity transformation (preferred).
• Demonstrated experience delivering training for Microsoft 365 (Teams/Office apps) and/or AI assistants.
• Certifications (preferred, not mandatory):
o Microsoft fundamentals / Modern Work / Copilot-related badges
o Change management (Prosci/ADKAR) or Design Thinking facilitation (bonus)

Deliverables Owned (What this role produces)
• Persona-based training strategy + learning paths
• Lesson plans + facilitator guides
• Copilot demo scripts and “show me” workflows
• Hands-on lab guides and learner workbooks
• Prompt library + persona scenario bank
• Change Corner runbooks + FAQs
• Targeted campaign content (tips, prompts, newsletters, success stories)
• TTT certification kit and trainer playbook
• Feedback insights and adoption improvement recommendations

Success Metrics / KPIs (Examples)
• Enablement coverage: # webinars, # learners trained, completion rates
• Adoption improvement: weekly/monthly active usage movement in target cohorts (tracked via dashboards)
• Capability transfer: # internal trainers certified (e.g., 30+)
• Scenario adoption: # validated persona scenarios in use
• Business outcomes: documented time savings / productivity gains + executive-ready value stories (and where available, ROI dashboards)
• Satisfaction: post-session CSAT, confidence uplift, reduced “how do I start” tickets

Nice-to-Have (Differentiators)
• Experience in regulated industries (insurance/financial services) and compliance-sensitive communication
• Familiarity with Copilot extensibility concepts (plugins/agents) at a functional level (not a developer requirement)
• Experience running enterprise communities (Viva Engage/Teams) and adoption hubs

Working Model / Stakeholders
• Works closely with: Program Lead / AI Office, Communications Lead, Security/Governance, and business SMEs.
• Supports joint operating cadence with the broader “one AI team” model where Copilot adoption is run in parallel with technical readiness.


Skills: Office 365 Administration~AI & Gen AI - Products & Tools
Experience Required: 10 & Above, Project Code :

Role: AWS Cloud Engineer

Descriptions:

AWS Cloud Engineer Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior AWS Cloud Engineer with deep hands-on experience in architecting, implementing, and migrating large-scale data solutions on AWS. This role focuses on on-premises to AWS data migration, large data storage architectures, and enterprise-grade data transfer solutions using AWS DataSync, S3 replication, and related AWS services. The ideal candidate will lead technical design, implementation, and optimization efforts while working closely with architecture, infrastructure, and security teams.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost-optimized AWS data storage architectures for large datasets.
Configure and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, Route 53, DataSync, S3 Replication, SageMaker, Glue, ELB, FSx, ECR, and Secrets Manager.
Lead on-premises to AWS cloud data migration initiatives, including planning, execution, validation, and cutover.
Architect and configure AWS DataSync for high-volume, reliable data transfers between on-prem systems and AWS.
Implement and manage Amazon S3 replication (CRR/SRR), lifecycle policies, encryption, and access controls.
Design and develop machine learning models using AWS SageMaker, integrated with Jupyter Notebook, to enable scalable model training, evaluation, and deployment.
Design solutions for large data ingestion, archival, backup, and disaster recovery using AWS services.
Perform hands-on implementation of AWS infrastructure using best practices and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Implement CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools.
Optimize data transfer performance, storage costs, and data durability.
Collaborate with application, database, network, and security teams to ensure seamless integrations.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex data migration and storage issues.
Enforce AWS security, governance, and compliance standards for data protection.
Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with at least 4+ years of hands-on AWS experience.
Strong hands-on experience with:
AWS DataSync
Amazon S3 (replication, lifecycle policies, versioning, encryption)
AWS SageMaker
Large-scale data storage and migration
Proven experience migrating terabytes to petabytes of data from on-premises environments to AWS.
Strong understanding of networking concepts (VPN, Direct Connect, bandwidth optimization).
Experience designing high-availability, fault-tolerant cloud architectures.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or equivalent).
Solid understanding of IAM, encryption (KMS), and AWS security best practices.
Ability to architect solutions, not just operate them.

Knowledge of feed file processing and data integration workflows
Understanding of multi-tier application architectures and component interactions

Knowledge of ITIL processes including incident, problem, and change management
Ability to work in 24x7 shift-based support environment
Experience with escalation procedures and vendor support coordination

Respond to production incidents and alerts within defined SLA timeframes
Perform initial analysis for application performance and functionality issues
Troubleshoot order processing failures, payment gateway issues, and checkout problems

MSP Owner: Shilpa Bajpai
Location: TAMPA/ FL, Dallas, TX, Basking Ridge/ NJ, Ashburn/ Virginia- 100% ONSITE
Duration: 6 months
GBaMS ReqID: 10695170

Note- Candidate must have exp in-
1. Telecom Exp is MUST
2. IBM Netcool - Tivoli NOI, AI Ops
___________________________________________________________________________
Netcool Developer with AIOps Cloud Pak

Role Descriptions: A Netcool Developer with AIOps Cloud Pak expertise is responsible for integrating and migrating traditional IBM Netcool Operations Insight (NOI) event management systems with the AI-powered capabilities of the IBM Cloud Pak for AIOps platform.

The role involves automating IT operations| reducing alert noise| and using AIML to predict and resolve incidents faster.
Key Responsibilities-
Integration and Migration Connecting existing on-premises Netcool Omnibus and Netcool Impact environments with IBM Cloud Pak for AIOps using provided connectors. This includes migrating existing event filters and runbook automation policies.
Event and Data Management Ensuring seamless bidirectional synchronization of event data between Netcool and the AIOps platform.
This involves configuring data mapping and transformation rules (often using JSONATA) for consistent alert and event processing across systems.
Automation Development Creating and implementing automation policies and runbooks (often using Netcool Impact policies and potentially Python Bash scripts) within the AIOps environment to automatically diagnose and remediate IT issues.AI Model Training and Management.
Assisting in feeding quality data to the AIOps platforms machine learning models to enable event grouping| log anomaly detection| metric anomaly detection| and change risk assessment.
Topology and Visualization Utilizing the AIOps platforms resource management and topology features to provide a unified| application-centric view of the IT infrastructure| helping to understand interdependencies and the potential impact of incidents.
Collaboration and Support Working with cross-functional teams (DevOps| SREs| etc.) to integrate data from various third-party tools (Splunk| ServiceNow| Slack| etc.) and ensure a cohesive| AI-driven operations platform.
Troubleshooting Diagnosing and resolving complex issues that arise during the integration and operation of the AIOps and Netcool systems in a hybrid cloud environment.

Required Skills- Expertise in IBM Netcool Suite In-depth knowledge of Netcool Omnibus| Netcool Impact| and their associated tools like probes| gateways| and the Web GUI, Project Code :

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in data architecture, cloud-based analytics solutions, and Salesforce data integration, along with strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

This role will be instrumental in building a robust data ecosystem to support analytics, reporting, and emerging AI-driven initiatives within a pharma domain context, particularly in Patient Support Programs (PSP).

---

Key Responsibilities

· Architecture & Design

o Lead end-to-end architecture design for enterprise data and analytics platforms.

o Define scalable, reliable, and secure data architecture patterns for structured and unstructured data.

· Salesforce Data Integration

o Architect and implement solutions for ingesting and processing data from Salesforce platforms (e.g., Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Health Cloud).

o Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across Salesforce and downstream systems.

· Cloud & Data Platforms

o Design and build scalable solutions leveraging modern cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).

o Implement data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.

o Optimize data processing frameworks for performance and cost efficiency.

· Analytics & Reporting

o Enable BI and reporting solutions using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

o Ensure data availability and performance for downstream analytics and reporting teams.

o Support advanced analytics use cases including predictive and prescriptive analytics.

· AI & Advanced Capabilities (Nice to Have)

o Contribute to AI/ML initiatives including data preparation for machine learning models.

o Drive adoption of AI-enabled analytics and automation solutions.

· Stakeholder Management

o Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and IT teams to align technical solutions with business goals.

o Translate business requirements into technical architecture and actionable road maps.

o Present architecture designs and solutions to senior leadership.

· Governance & Best Practices

o Establish and enforce data governance, security, and compliance standards.

o Promote best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and DevOps.

o Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, especially within the pharma domain.

---

Required Skills & Qualifications

· 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or Analytics Platforms

· Strong expertise in:

o Data architecture (data modeling, warehousing, integration)

o ETL/ELT tools and frameworks

o Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

· Proven experience in Salesforce data integration and architecture

· Experience designing scalable, enterprise-grade data platforms

· Knowledge of BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

· Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration

---

Nice to Have

· Experience with AI/ML implementation or data support for AI initiatives

· Knowledge of Patient Support Programs (PSP) in the Pharma/Life Sciences domain

· Familiarity with data governance and compliance standards (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.)

---

Soft Skills

· Strong leadership and decision-making capability

· Ability to influence stakeholders and drive consensus

· Strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset

Role Descriptions: · Serve as the primary functional authority for design, implementation, and optimization of patient support programs (HUB, adherence, financial assistance, case management, nurse outreach).

· Map and optimize the patient journey from diagnosis -> treatment initiation -> adherence -> ongoing support, identifying key touchpoints, handoffs, and escalation paths.

· Define and document functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and user stories for program platforms, CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), vendor portals, and integrations (EMR, specialty pharmacy, payer systems).

· Lead data migration functional planning and validation for patient and case data (source-to-target mapping, de-duplication strategy, data quality rules, reconciliation criteria).

· Translate regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, local data protection, adverse event reporting) into operational controls and system configuration requirements.

· Work with vendors and internal IT to design integrations with specialty pharmacies, distributors, third-party administrators, and payer clearinghouses; ensure seamless prescription routing and status updates.

· Establish KPIs and outcomes for patient support (time-to-first-dose, enrollment conversion, adherence rates, patient satisfaction, financial assistance utilization); set up dashboards and reporting requirements.

· Provide subject-matter guidance to project teams, and commercial strategy; facilitate cross-functional workshops and decision sessions.

· Develop SOPs, process flows, training materials, and acceptance test scripts; conduct or support end-user training and UAT.

· Participate in pilot designs, proof-of-concept testing, rollouts, and continuous improvement initiatives; champion patient-centric design principles.


Required Qualifications

· 7+ years of hands-on experience in patient support programs / HUB operations / patient services within the pharmaceutical sector .

· Demonstrated expertise with specialty pharmacy workflows, prescription fulfillment and dispense lifecycles, and payer/patient reimbursement pathways.

· Proven experience defining functional requirements and delivering projects involving CRM systems (Salesforce experience strongly preferred).

· Experience leading or contributing to data migration efforts for patient/case data, including mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.

· Strong knowledge of patient privacy and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, local privacy laws, pharmacovigilance reporting obligations).

· Excellent stakeholder management skills — able to influence cross-functional teams including commercial, medical, legal/compliance, IT, and external vendors.

· Strong process design and documentation skills (SOPs, process maps, acceptance criteria, test plans).

· Demonstrable track record of driving measurable operational improvements and implementing KPIs for patient support services.

· Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Healthcare Management, Business, or related field. Advanced degree or relevant certifications a plus.


Preferred / Highly Desirable

· Direct experience implementing Salesforce Health Cloud, Service Cloud, or similar CRM platforms in a patient-support context.

· Hands-on experience with specialty pharmacy or HUB vendor integrations and knowledge of standards/APIs used for prescription/fulfillment (e.g., HL7, FHIR concepts, EDI).

· Experience with cloud-based deployments, CI/CD for configuration-driven platforms, or working alongside technical architects on integration architecture.

· Experience in global program roll-outs or multi-country regulatory environments.

· Background in nursing, pharmacy, or case management with practical patient-facing experience.

· Familiarity with digital engagement tools (patient portals, mobile apps, chatbots) and behavior-change approaches to improve adherence.

· Knowledge of co-pay accumulator rules, savings card mechanics, manufacturer-sponsored PAPs, and third-party payer interactions.


Core Skills & Competencies


· Patient-centric mindset .

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with both qualitative process detail and quantitative metrics.

· Clear, concise communicator; able to produce high quality documentation and deliver compelling stakeholder presentations.

· Project-oriented with ability to work in agile and waterfall environments; comfortable with ambiguity and able to drive decisions.

· Detail-oriented with excellent quality assurance focus for data and process validation.

· Leadership presence; able to mentor junior staff and lead cross-functional teams.


Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)

· Complete full patient journey mapping and gap analysis for targeted program(s) and present prioritized roadmap.

· Deliver functional requirements and acceptance criteria for CRM/HUB enhancements, enabling development sprint work.

· Define and implement a comprehensive data migration validation framework and lead one successful migration pilot.

· Establish baseline KPIs and dashboards for program performance and patient outcomes with initial recommendations for improvement.

· Achieve stakeholder alignment across commercial, medical, and compliance on program design and SOPs.

Essential Skills: Patient Support Program SME

Experience Required: 10 & Above, Project Code :

o Validation execution and reporting

o ISO 13485 standards

o Risk management (ISO 14971)

· Experience in regulated environments with minimal supervision

· Ability to independently manage multiple protocols simultaneously


Preferred Skills

similar platforms like Elita)

We are looking for experienced Validation & Verification (V&V) experts to support protocol

development and execution for the Elita system. The role requires independent ownership of

end-to-end V&V activities with minimal onboarding or training. The candidate will contribute

toward executing approximately 150–170 validation protocols within a defined timeline

validation, software validation, etc.)

· Ensure all validation activities comply with regulatory standards (FDA, ISO 13485, 21

CFR Part 820)

· Drive end-to-end protocol lifecycle, including:

o Protocol authoring

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams (R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory)

MSP Owner: Zach Provence
Location: ~Raritan, NJ~
Duration: 6 months
GBaMS ReqID: 10767797


Role Descriptions: Led end-to-end SAP APO implementations/support across DP, SNP, PP/DS, and GATP from requirement gathering through design, configuration, testing (UT/SIT/UAT), cutover, and hypercare.

Conducted business workshops to map planning and fulfillment processes, documented AS-IS/TO-BE flows, and translated requirements into functional designs and configuration workbooks.

Built and stabilized APO–ERP integration using CIF by creating/maintaining integration models, monitoring and troubleshooting qRFC queues, and performing data reconciliation between APO and ERP.

Ensured APO master data readiness and governance, including products, locations, resources, calendars, planning horizons, transportation lanes, quota arrangements, and PDS/PPM structures.

Configured SAP APO Demand Planning (DP) planning areas, key figures, planning levels, time series settings, and versions aligned to S&OP/consensus demand processes.

Implemented and tuned DP statistical forecasting (model selection/parameters), managed outliers and intermittency, and developed macros to support forecast adjustments and exception-based planning.

Defined forecast validation approach and improved forecast quality using KPIs such as bias and MAPE, partnering with business users to drive adoption of standard planning practices.

Configured SAP APO Supply Network Planning (SNP) for multi-echelon supply networks, including sourcing, lead times, lot sizing, safety stock inputs, and constraint handling.

Executed and tuned SNP planning runs (heuristics and/or optimizer where applicable), analyzed results, and refined planning logic to balance service levels, inventory, and capacity feasibility.

Implemented SNP deployment and replenishment logic and (where required) Transport Load Builder (TLB) to support shipment consolidation and executable supply plans.

Configured SAP APO PP/DS for finite scheduling and detailed sequencing, including capacities, modes, setup times (including sequence-dependent setups if used), and pegging strategies.

Maintained PP/DS PDS/PPM alignment with ERP BOM/routings/production versions and ensured correct order creation/transfer for planned orders and production/process orders.

Functional Knowledge

• Recommends process, technology, and delivery improvements to enhance efficiency, resiliency, and business alignment.

Leadership & Project Management

• Establishes project execution strategies, governance structures, and delivery cadence.
• Influences without authority by aligning diverse stakeholder groups around common objectives and timelines.

• Applies structured problem solving to technical, scheduling, and stakeholder issues with broad business impact.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in physical security, security technology, or infrastructure project management.

• Project management experience using structured methodologies, scheduling tools, and reporting frameworks. (PSP, PMM, Agile)

Skills
• Strong project and program management capabilities.
• Excellent stakeholder engagement and cross functional coordination skills.
• Budget tracking, schedule management, and risk mitigation.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and sustainability.
• High proficiency in Microsoft Office and security project documentation tools., Project Code :

o Meeting with Client business analyst to understand requirements

o Support the solution through deployment and operations
o Strong analytical ability
o Ability to work with all teams and understand code changes and review business requirements and identify any gaps, Project Code :

data.public_job_desc:
Bill Rate: MAX CONFIRMED $65 to $70
Location: ONSITE- Phoenix AZ
Duration: 6 months

Role: Agile Coach

Descriptions:

"The Agile Coach is a cornerstone role in building and shaping a new Agile Center of Excellence from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to help define how Agile comes to life across IT, working alongside teams as they take their very first steps on their Agile journey and experience the power of great execution.
Rather than operating from the sidelines, this role embeds directly with delivery teams to make Agile real. The Agile Coach brings sprint ceremonies to life, strengthens delivery discipline, and partners closely with product owners, scrum leads, engineers, and IT leaders to drive meaningful progress. Through hands on coaching, the role removes blockers, addresses Agile anti patterns, and builds strong, resilient team dynamics in real time.
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in the early stages of transformation, and is excited to influence mindsets, establish working norms, and help teams achieve their first wins while navigating early challenges. The Agile Coach will have a visible and lasting impact by setting the foundation for consistent delivery, scalable practices, and a shared understanding of what “great Agile” truly looks like, starting from day one.
• Responsibilities
o Provide hands-on Agile coaching by embedding with delivery teams and leaders to strengthen execution, reinforce effective Agile practices, and improve delivery outcomes.

o Coach teams, Product Owners, and Scrum Leads to improve flow, clarify roles, maintain healthy backlogs, and consistently deliver usable working outcomes.

o Identify and address delivery blockers, Agile anti-patterns, and team or leadership behaviors that negatively impact predictability and throughput.

o Support Agile adoption efforts by coaching teams and leaders through onboarding, launch, and stabilization phases, and helping the organization transition to Agile ways of working.

o Reinforce consistent use of Agile tools and practices to ensure work remains visible, current, and aligned to agreed execution standards, enabling reliable insights and data driven improvement.

o Partner with the Agile Center of Excellence to share lessons learned, support lightweight standards and training, and continuously improve Agile enablement approaches across IT.

• Qualifications
o 8+ years of related experience in Project Management or similar field.
o Bachelor's degree in related field required.
o Previous leadership experience preferred.
o Intermediate knowledge of general Financial Services or Banking is preferred.
o Intermediate knowledge of applicable regulatory and legal compliance obligations, rules and regulations, industry standards and practices.
o Intermediate to advanced experience in IT project management managing large, complex projects with a proven track record of delivering projects on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
o Advanced experience working with project management tools (e.g., Workfront, MS Project, or similar).
o Strong understanding of IT systems, software development life cycles (SDLC), and cloud technologies while also demonstrating strong organizational and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
o Advanced speaking and writing communication skills.
o Project Management Professional Certification, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification
o May require up to 25% travel.", Project Code :
